원하는 총기류가 있다면 이 서류에 신청서를 작성하라구. 아마 일주일 내에: If there's a firearm you want, fill out an application on this document. You should be able to have it airlifted in within a week, so it's best to apply as soon as possible. Of course, I've already got a few decent pieces in stock, so take a look around.
I'll take a look and see if there's a decent gun.
I'd like to sell some items.
I have other business to attend to, so I'll be going.
There's nothing like a shotgun for blowing a vampire's head off in one shot.
People handling a gun for the first time tend to get excited, and that lowers their accuracy.
무조건 먼저 쏜다고 이긴다고 생각하지마. 자신의 위치를 노출시킬 수도 있: Don't assume shooting first always means winning. It can also expose your position.
비록 내가 한쪽 눈을 잃었지만, 아마 자네보다는 총을 잘 쏘지 않을까?: Even though I've lost one eye, I'd wager I can still shoot better than you.
Looking for an SMG? Go meet that stubborn Spartan.
전투 때는 자기 몸은 자기가 지킬 수 있어야만 한다. 뒤돌아 보며 신경쓸: In battle, you must be able to defend yourself. There's no time to look back and worry — fight facing only forward. Your comrades will guard your back. If you're not confident, I suggest you quit the mercenary trade as soon as possible.
Thanks for the good advice. Anyway, I came here to buy an SMG.
제가 가지고 있는 물건들을 팔고 싶습니다. 스파르탄: I'd like to sell the items I have. Spartan.
훗. 이제 갓 들어온 신병 아닌가?: Heh. You're a fresh recruit, aren't you?
People call me crazy, but I'm perfectly sane.
뱀파이어들이 내가 만든 폭탄에 산산조각나는 모습을 보면 정말 쾌감이 느껴: Watching vampires get blown to pieces by bombs I made gives me real satisfaction.
Need an SMG? Then come here, friend.
폭탄을 만든다는 것은 생각보다 쉬워. 대신 잘못하면 죽기도 쉽지. 하하하: Making bombs is easier than you'd think. But mess up and dying is just as easy. Hahaha.
If you're looking for a rifle or shotgun, go see Drake.
적의 심장을 노리고 방아쇠를 당기는 기분을 알아? 그 대상이 만약 나와: Do you know what it feels like to pull the trigger aiming for an enemy's heart? If I imagine that target were once a close comrade of mine, it makes my head spin... those few seconds evading enemy eyes, aiming for the heart, before pulling the trigger — that's a moment that drains you dry. What I do is that thrilling. What do you say, want to learn?
Jan, today I've come to learn a new technique.
스릴도 좋지만, 새 라이플을 사려고 하는데요?: Thrills are all well and good, but I'm actually here to buy a new rifle.
I'd like to sell these items.
No. I'll learn it another time.
The most important thing when sniping is your own breathing.
You have to blow a vampire's heart away in a single shot.
A rose is truly beautiful and captivating. That's what I think, anyway.
Sniping is tougher than it looks. It only seems cool in the movies.
사람들이 가끔 나를 보고 \"장미의 저격수\"라고 부르는데, 사실 그 별: People sometimes call me the "Rose Sniper," but honestly, I don't like that nickname.
If you want to buy a submachine gun, look for a guy named Spartan.
이곳 에슬라니아는 매우 위험한 곳입니다. 그러니, 이 넓은 곳을 걸어다니: Eslania is an extremely dangerous place. So carrying out missions on foot across this vast land is nothing but reckless — it only increases the time you're exposed to danger... If you'd like, I could provide you with a motorcycle I've modified myself... would you like to take a look?
Frederick. Please show me a new bike.
I'd like to retrieve the motorcycle I left with you.
No. I'm not planning to buy a bike just yet. I'll come by another time.
Have you heard vampires run legitimate companies? Tch.
모터사이클의 개조는 제게 맡기세요. 전투에는 비록 도움이 안되지만, 이런: Leave motorcycle modification to me. It's no help in combat, but this much I can do...
제가 살던 성은 정말 아름다웠어요. 언젠가 제가 다시 그 성을 되찾기만: The castle I used to live in was truly beautiful. If only I could reclaim it someday...
제가 보기엔 E.V.E는 조금 느슨한 조직인 것 같아요. 물론 TEAM: In my view, E.V.E seems like a somewhat loose organization. Though TEAM TWO is different, of course.
If you want to buy body armor or a helmet, go find Sonya.
물품관리는 저에게 맡기고, 전투에만 신경쓰세요. 지금 뭐 맡기실 물건이라: Leave item management to me and focus only on combat. Do you have anything to store with me right now?
Kristin, I'd like to buy a new storage locker.
I'd like to see my Market shopping basket.
I'd like to see my pet storage.
I don't have anything in particular to store right now. Well then.
I'm in a management role for now, but I'll be jumping into combat myself soon.
제가 8년간 용병생활을 했다는 사실, 혹시 들은 적 없나요?: Have you ever heard that I spent eight years as a mercenary?
소설이나 영화에서만 보던 것들이 실존하리라고는 누가 상상이나 했겠어요?: Who would have imagined that things we only ever saw in novels and movies would actually exist?
My son too... at the hands of vampires... *sob*...
I can't forgive them. So, I became a mercenary again.
Leave item management to me, and focus only on combat.
Items you buy at the Daden Market or receive as gifts are kept in this shopping basket. You can come to me to retrieve stored items too. You know that, right? Unlike storage, the shopping basket only holds gifted or purchased items — you can't use it to store your own belongings like a storage locker. If some of your purchased items don't seem to be showing up in the basket, don't worry — they're not gone, they'll appear once you've claimed the current items in the basket. So, would you like to check the shopping basket?
Yes, I'd like to check my shopping basket.
No. I'll check it another time.
COME BACK,2005 이벤트 대상자시군요. 이벤트에 참여하신 분들에: You're eligible for the COME BACK 2005 event. Participants are being given a commemorative item, so please take one. Also, if you sign up for a premium payment during the event period, you'll receive a Yeollab Set item as a payment bonus.
Yes, I'd like to receive the event item.
Yes, I've signed up for the payment. I'd like to receive the Yeollab Set item.
참, 이벤트 아이템은 한계정당 한 개의 아이템만 지급됩니다. 지금 접속중: By the way, only one event item is given per account. Would you like to receive the item on the character you're currently logged in as?
Yes, I'll receive it on this character.
No, I'll receive it on a different character.
COME BACK,2005 이벤트 대상자로부터 추천을 받으셨다고요? 좋은: You were referred by a COME BACK 2005 event participant? Well done. I can't just let that go. Take this item. Please keep referring people in the future too.
Yes, thank you, I'll gladly accept.
Seems I was misinformed. I'm sorry.
안녕하세요? 이번엔 무엇을 도와드릴까요? 수리할 게 있으면 꼭 말씀해주세: Hello there? What can I help you with this time? If you have anything to repair, be sure to let me know.
Hello there, Griffin. Please repair this for me.
Yes. I'll be sure to bring it up next time. Take care.
아버님께 제가 잘있다고 좀 전해주세요. 바빠서 요즘은 잘 뵙지도 못하네요: Please tell my father I'm doing well. I've been too busy to see him much lately.
Hmm... now this is quite a good theory... yes... that's it...
The field I'm interested in is biochemistry. Though I'm still at a beginner level...
Biochemistry is a truly fascinating field. You should really study it.
매일 전투를 하느라 피곤하겠군. 어디 다친 곳이 있으면 빨리 나를 찾아오: You must be exhausted from fighting every day. If you're hurt anywhere, come find me quickly. I'll do my best to treat you.
Sing, I'm hurt here. Please treat me.
I'd like to buy some healing ampoules.
이것들을 혹시 사주시겠습니까?: Would you be willing to buy these from me?
I can still manage for now. I'll stop by another time.
어때? 이제 아픈 데는 없는가?: How is it? Does anything still hurt?
Take even a small wound lightly, and it could end up killing you.
Always remember how to give first aid. It'll definitely come in handy.
If possible, it's better for you not to have to come see me. Haha.
When using an ampoule, be careful not to let air get into the bloodstream.
Hm? I'll need to request more injections and sedatives. We're running quite low.
자네, 알고 있는가? 예브게니가 뱀파이어들의 마법을 보호할 수 있는 물건: Did you know? I hear Yevgeni sells items that can protect against vampire magic. If you're interested, head up to the second floor.
밖에서는 뱀파이어와의 전쟁이 한참이겠죠? 저도 안에서 여러분들을 위해서: The war against the vampires must be raging outside, right? I pray for all of you inside here every day too. Anyway... if you need any accessories, tell me. I'll get them for you as best I can... The items I sell can protect you from vampire magic. Would you like to see?
예브게니, 새로 들어온 악세서리들을 보여주세요: Yevgeni, please show me the accessories that just came in.
이것들을 팔려고 하는데.. 어때요?: I'd like to sell these... what do you think?
I'll be going now. Take care, Yevgeni...
Everyone says I have a handsome forehead. Hehe.
I love Hannibal — no, my father — so much.
Let's pray together for the souls of those who have passed...
I have rings, necklaces, and bracelets ready here.
제가 준비한 악세서리들이 부족하시면, 무사길드나 군인길드 2층으로 가 보: If the accessories I have aren't enough, try the second floor of the Warrior Guild or the Soldier Guild. They should have what you're looking for.
제가 아직 어리긴 하지만, 사랑하는 일이 얼마나 신성하고 중요한 일인지는: I'm still young, but I understand very well how sacred and important love is. Don't worry.
Always cherish your beloved. They're someone precious to share your life with.
사랑은 인생에서 큰 부분을 차지하고 있습니다. 함께 할 믿을 수 있는 누: Love occupies a large part of life. Having someone trustworthy to share it with is a great blessing. Sometimes a wrong choice can leave wounds on each other and lead to a breakup. For your own sake, and for the sake of the one you love, choose carefully.
I've found someone I love. I'd like to register as a couple.
I'll grant approval for the couple registration.
Our relationship no longer means anything. I want to break up.
제 파트너의 이름을 잊었습니다. 가르쳐 주시겠습니까?: I've forgotten my partner's name. Could you tell me?
I'd like to ask you something else.
헤어지길 원하실 경우, 두 가지 방법이 있습니다. 서로의 합의 하에 이루: If you wish to break up, there are two methods: a mutual breakup by agreement of both parties, and a one-sided breakup without agreement. However, if you choose a one-sided breakup, remember that your alignment will decrease.
I'll break up by mutual agreement.
I'll break up unilaterally, without agreement.
앉아서 기도만 하고 있다고 문제가 해결되는 건 아니지.. 이제는 행동으로: Problems don't get solved just by sitting and praying... I believe it's time to show it through action now. I'll provide the finest equipment for battle, so won't you take care of the vampires?
Understood, Nikolai. Then, please show me the finest equipment.
I'd like to sell the equipment I have.
내 조국 러시아를 욕보이는 자들은 용서할 수 없어!: I cannot forgive those who disgrace my homeland, Russia!
내 관심은 오로지 내 조국을 더럽히는 뱀파이어들을 쓸어버리는 것.. 그: My only concern is sweeping away the vampires that defile my homeland... that's all.
자본주의가 더 우월하다고? 그럼 굶어죽어가는 미국의 아이들은 뭐야?: Capitalism is superior, you say? Then what about the children starving to death in America?
This isn't the time for such talk. Come on. Everyone, get ready and move out.
여기저기 돌아다니다 보니 요즘 들어 뱀파이어의 활동이 더 활발해진 것 같: Traveling around here and there, it seems vampire activity has grown more active lately. We can't afford to let this go on any longer... I need you all to work a bit harder. Here, I have some items I gathered during my travels. Would you like to take a look?
Please show me if you have anything I need.
Let me show you what I've gathered so far.
I'll see you next time, Richardson.
Of all the places I've been, Korea was the most beautiful.
I suppose I must have wanderlust in me. Heh heh heh.
You could say there's hardly a place on Earth my feet haven't touched. Heh heh.
From what I've heard, vampire masters are gathering one after another.
There's a rumor that every necropolis across the world has been emptied out.
주님의 은총이 가득하기를... 누구나 마음속에 두려움을 하나씩 가지고 있: May the Lord's grace be with you... Everyone carries a fear in their heart, but that doesn't mean fear serves no purpose. Sometimes it protects your body, and can even be transformed into great strength. But in the final moment, you must not let fear taint your faith. If you have time today, I'd like to share true faith with you... what do you say?
Hannibal, please teach me a new blessing spell.
I've heard you have some fine maces. I'd like to take a look.
This time I've come by to sell the items I have.
I'll be on my way. Please bless me, Hannibal.
자네들이 수고해준 덕분에 더 많은 자료를 얻을 수 있게 되었네. 나는 예: Thanks to your hard work, I've been able to gather more material. I've been researching the legends of the Ousters for some time now. If they were to be revived, something terrible would surely happen. They're said to be a primitive race that worships nature rather than the Lord, but it's told they wield fearsome power drawn from idols they call spirits. Such power could hardly be righteous, of course. Don't you agree?
Yes, that could well be so.
예전 같으면 나도 아우스터즈를 만나러 한달음에 달려갔을텐데… 솔직히 말해: In the old days, I'd have rushed off to meet the Ousters myself... Honestly, even though they're creatures that go against the Lord's will, I'd like to see that legend with my own eyes and speak with them. Be careful if you encounter them. They may be victims once bitten by vampires, but they're also beings who have avoided contact with humans. It's only a hunch, but there's a good chance they're dangerous.
I'll be careful, just as you say.
아우스터즈는 뱀파이어가 없이는 존재할 수 없는 생명체이지. 악의 부산물이: The Ousters are creatures that cannot exist without vampires. You could even call them a byproduct of evil. Yet it's said that, through some trigger, they managed to reproduce. The second-generation Ousters born this way have no sex, but they lay something called a 'germ,' like an egg. Hmm... whether to call it an egg or half of a baby, I'm not sure... but in any case, it's said that if you lay a germ and place it next to another germ, it becomes a baby Ouster.
흠… 그들은 대한 이야기는 먼저 카이저에게 듣고 오는 것이 좋겠네. 나중: Hmm... for more about them, you'd best go hear it from Kaiser first. There will be a chance to talk in more detail later. More than that, I'm worried your faith seems to be weakening. I have a wonderful story about faith in the Lord. What do you say, would you like to hear it?
